items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You had done a date in 1955 with Gene Ammons. It’s the one sideman recording with you that I know of from that period.

ctx.x: To steady down the rhythm. That’s all.
You had done a date in 1955 with Gene Ammons. It’s the one sideman recording with you that I know of from that period. I know that he also liked to use the congas.
